description: This file defines the IP controller class for the Opencart admin fraud extension, handling IP management functions such as listing, adding, removing IPs, and managing fraud IP settings.

classes.name: Ip
classes.description: Controller class for managing IP addresses related to fraud detection in Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the IP management page with breadcrumbs, settings, and IP list.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the fraud IP settings via POST request.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs the fraud IP extension if user has permission.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls the fraud IP extension if user has permission.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of IPs with associated customer counts.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP to the fraud list after validation.

methods.name: removeIp
methods.description: Removes an IP from the fraud list.
